cases.situation: Junior on my team, Nadia, handled a tense client call today really well. Client pushed hard on the delay and she kept it calm. Want to tell her on Slack.
cases.reply: Nadia, the way you handled the Brightwell call today was great. When they pushed on the delay, you gave them the new date and the reason in two sentences and they settled right down. I'm borrowing that.

cases.situation: 领导王总在部门群里夸我这次展会方案做得好，其实是我和小周一起做的。怎么回比较得体？
cases.reply: 谢谢王总！这次确实花了不少心思，看到效果挺开心的。物料和现场流程小周出了很多力，这份功劳有她一半。
cases.note: 先大方接住，再提同事，不要一上来就说"没有没有，都是大家的功劳"。

cases.situation: I'm a contractor redoing a client's kitchen. He keeps texting stuff like 'you look great in those overalls ha'. I want to shut it down but keep the job.
cases.reply: I'd rather keep things to the project, thanks. Speaking of which, countertop templating is booked for Thursday at 9.
cases.note: Plain, short and back to the work. If it happens again, say it once more and keep a record of the messages.

cases.situation: When I was in hospital for 5 days in August, my neighbour Glen walked and fed my dog Biscuit twice a day without me having to ask twice. Now I'm back on my feet I want to send him a proper thank-you text.
cases.reply: Glen, I've been meaning to say this properly. When I was in hospital in August, knowing Biscuit was being walked and fed twice a day by someone she adores meant I could actually rest instead of lying there worrying. She still pulls towards your door every time we pass it. Thank you, truly.
cases.note: What he did, what it made possible, one line about him, and no favour or gift attached, so it stays a thank-you.

cases.situation: Our VP, Carla, ran the all-hands today about the reorg and answered every hard question straight, including admitting she got the timing of the announcement wrong. I'm two levels below her. I want to send a short message without sounding like I'm sucking up.
cases.reply: Carla, thank you for today's all-hands. When you said the timing of the announcement was your call and the wrong one, the room noticeably relaxed. It made the rest of what you said much easier to trust.
cases.note: To someone senior: short, one specific moment and its effect, and nothing asked in return.

cases.situation: 儿子乐乐上二年级，开学时每天早上哭着不肯去。班主任刘老师这一个月每天在校门口接他，还让他当了图书角管理员，现在他天天催着出门。想在微信上好好谢谢刘老师。
cases.reply: 刘老师，想正式跟您说声谢谢。开学那几周乐乐每天早上都哭，您每天在门口接他，还让他管图书角，现在他七点就催我出门，说要去整理书。这一个月的变化我们在家看得特别清楚，您真的很用心。
cases.note: 感谢要具体：她做了什么、带来了什么变化、一句关于她本人；不附带任何请求。

cases.situation: I told Ben, a colleague on another team, that his talk at the product offsite was the clearest explanation of our pricing I'd ever heard. He DM'd back 'haha careful, people will think you're flirting'. I'm married and it really wasn't that. We work together on a project next month.
cases.reply: Ha, no angle here, I just thought it was good and wanted to say so. The slide with the three customer examples is what finally made our pricing click for me.
cases.note: Clarify in one plain line without apologising for the compliment, then restate the specific thing so it stays about the work.

cases.situation: My friend Hana played her first open mic on Saturday and was genuinely great, especially her own song about her grandmother. I texted her that and she replied 'omg no, I was so off-key in the second verse, it was a mess'.
cases.reply: I mean it, the song about your grandmother gave me chills, second verse and all. Nice work.
cases.note: When they deflect, don't argue them into accepting it. Repeat it once, shorter, and leave it.

cases.situation: My mom was on the cardiac ward at St. Luke's for 9 days in September. One nurse, Joanne, explained every medication to her in plain words and came back after her shift ended to check on her the night before surgery. I want to email Joanne and copy her ward manager.
cases.reply: Dear Joanne, I wanted to thank you for how you cared for my mother, Linda Price, on the cardiac ward in September. You explained every new medication to her in plain words, and for the first time in months she understood her own treatment. The night before her surgery you came back after your shift just to check on her. She still tells everyone about that visit. Thank you. With gratitude, Emma Price
cases.note: Copying the manager makes the thanks count where it matters to her; keep it to what she did and what it changed, with nothing asked.

cases.situation: 姑姑在家族群里发了我们国庆前聚会的照片，还@我说'瘦了好多，比以前好看多了！'。其实我是前段时间生病才瘦的，不想在群里解释，也不想冷场。
cases.reply: 谢谢姑姑！我现在挺好的，照片也拍得好看。对了，上次您说表妹要去杭州读研，定下来了吗？
cases.note: 收下好意，不解释原因，也不纠正她；一句感谢后把话题交还给对方，病情可以只和想说的人私下讲。

cases.situation: My wife Maya hosted her first Diwali dinner last night, 14 people including my parents. She made my dad his own mild dal because he can't do spice, and my mum said in the car it was the best Diwali she's had in years. I want to text Maya today.
cases.reply: Maya, I keep thinking about last night. You cooked for fourteen, remembered Dad can't do spice and made him his own dal, and still found time to sit down and laugh with everyone. Mum told me in the car it was the best Diwali she's had in years. I'm so proud of you.
cases.note: Partners get generic praise most of all; name the choices she made and pass on the effect, with nothing attached.

cases.situation: My 15-year-old son Eli's team lost the county basketball semi-final on Saturday by four points. He barely scored, but every time one of the younger players missed, he was the first to pick them up and talk them back into it. He's been gloomy since and I want to text him.
cases.reply: Eli, I keep thinking about Saturday. Every time one of the younger guys missed, you were the first one there, pulling him up and talking him back into the game. That's the kind of teammate people remember, and I was really proud watching it.
cases.note: Praise the choice he made, not the score, and keep any 'next time' advice out of the same message.

cases.situation: Aisha, who has reported to me for three years, is leaving for a job in Lisbon. On Slack today she wrote 'you're honestly the best manager I've ever had, I learned so much from you'. I tend to brush this stuff off and I don't want to this time.
cases.reply: Thank you, Aisha, that really means a lot to read. I've tried hard to be the manager I wish I'd had early on, so I'm glad it showed. Keep in touch, I want to hear how Lisbon goes.
cases.note: Receiving praise from someone junior: accept it plainly and don't bounce it straight back; save your praise of her for its own message.

cases.situation: 上周我搬家，我爸从老家开了六个小时车过来，两天里帮我把柜子全装好，换了漏水的水龙头，走的时候还把冰箱塞满了饺子。我们家平时不太说这些话，想发微信好好谢谢他。
cases.reply: 爸，到家了吧？这次搬家多亏您，开六个小时车过来，两天就把柜子全装好了，漏水的龙头也换了，我一个人得折腾两个礼拜。今天打开冰箱，满满都是您包的饺子，一下子觉得这个新家有家的样子了。谢谢爸。
cases.note: 家里越不常说谢谢，越要具体：他做了什么、帮你省了什么、给你带来什么感觉，不附带任何请求。

cases.situation: I'm a wedding photographer. The bride, Mariana, just texted that the photos of her grandmother dancing made the whole family cry and that I was 'the best decision of the wedding'. I want to thank her without false modesty, and without sliding in a request for a review.
cases.reply: Mariana, what a lovely message, thank you. I worked hard to catch those moments with your grandmother, so hearing they made everyone cry means a lot. It was a joy to photograph a day with that much love in it.
cases.note: Accept it and stop: no bounce-back and no ask. If you want a review, ask in a separate message a few days later.

cases.situation: After my quarterly forecast presentation, a senior colleague, Derek, posted in the team Slack channel: 'wow, that was actually really good, didn't expect that from you!'. The forecast section took me two weeks. I want to reply without being prickly or letting the dig slide into how people see me.
cases.reply: Thanks, Derek. The forecast section took a couple of weeks to get right, so I'm glad it landed.
cases.note: A backhanded compliment: take the compliment, ignore the dig, and name the work. If the pattern repeats, raise it with him privately, not in the channel.

cases.situation: 周会上领导表扬了这次销售报表按时上线，但没提到实习生小杨。其实她花了两周，把三年的历史订单数据一条条清洗对齐，我们后面做分析几乎没返工。想在项目群里专门夸她一下。
cases.reply: 补充一句：这次报表能按时上线，小杨功不可没。她花了两周把三年的历史订单数据一条条清洗对齐，我们后面做分析几乎没返工。谢谢小杨！
cases.note: 在群里替被忽略的人补上功劳：说清她具体做了什么、带来了什么效果，不带对领导的抱怨。
